Before founding The Delashmit Firm, he defended insurance companies in car-accident, work-injury, dog-bite, and slip-and-fall claims. He now uses that experience for the injured person: he knows how the adjuster values a claim, and what it takes to move that number. Hunter has recovered millions of dollars for his clients. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome; every case depends on its own facts. Learn More About Hunter Personal Injury Car wrecks, trucking collisions, motorcycle accidents, and unsafe premises — if someone else's negligence injured you, we deal with the insurance company so you can focus on healing. You pay nothing unless we recover for you. Workers' Compensation Hurt on the job in Georgia? We handle the State Board of Workers' Compensation process end to end — income benefits, medical treatment disputes, and settlements — so your employer's insurer doesn't get the only word. The Delashmit Firm Is Here for You Founding Attorney Legal problems of any kind can be incredibly stressful. During this challenging time, a dedicated, available, and reliable attorney can make a significant difference in the outcome of your matter. We appreciate the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of our clients by providing sound and supportive legal guidance. The Delashmit Firm prides itself on framing complex legal issues into language that you can easily digest. We treat clients with respect and spend time to make sure that they fully understand the process they are going through.
